title: Produce Traceability Inspection Log
subtitle: Produce Traceability: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: Produce Traceability Inspection Log covers produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event. The traceability coordinator records Produce Traceability check times, results, excursions, and review. Produce Traceability Inspection Log keeps Produce Traceability exceptions visible until the traceability coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Produce Traceability Inspection Log at field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point. Document produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event identity before Produce Traceability begins. Compare produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event findings with stated Produce Traceability criteria; route unresolved Produce Traceability issues to qualified produce-record reviewer. For Produce Traceability Inspection Log, confirm requirements for Produce Traceability. Ask qualified produce-record reviewer to review Produce Traceability conditions beyond the traceability coordinator's role.

sections.title: Log period and monitored subject
sections.guidance: For Produce Traceability, identify responsible parties, field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point, and the linked produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event source.

fields.label: Grower, field, harvest date, and crew
Pack, pallet, shipment, customer, and destination

sections.title: Monitoring review and control results
sections.guidance: Capture Produce Traceability facts for produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability monitored controls
items: Trace exercise, discrepancy, and corrective action

sections.title: Excursions, period result, and next review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Produce Traceability log excursions; have traceability coordinator record the period result, review owner, and next monitoring point.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Produce Traceability when source, lot, quantity, transformation, recipient, or affected-scope trace remains unresolved. Retain the available Produce Traceability proof and route unresolved produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event scope to traceability coordinator.
